name: Pirtó (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Pirtó: a blue and yellow shield with a tree, a deer, a sun, reeds, a sheep and waves, supported by two red-clad figures.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
